support_rule: Target empirical upper bounds for all features and lower bounds for nondefects only. Do not increase defects to satisfy target minima.
missing_rule: Only missing diacetyl with an explicit zero in attachment 8 receives a zero cap. This is a nonnegative-concentration bound, not median imputation or recovery of a raw CSV measurement.
stale_loss_comparison: Fixed mean/median baselines, previous squared-error tree, absolute-error tree and absolute-error boosting; no repeated tuning. Retain existing three proxy guards. No new reliable Stale predictor is presumed.
